domains.description: List of domain names (e.g., ['example.com']) to configure in SSSD.

name.description: Domain name (e.g., 'example.com'); must match the realm name and one entry in 'domains'.

ldap_uri.description: LDAP URIs for domain controllers (space-separated). Prefer ldaps:// for TLS.

search_base.description: Base DN to search for users and groups in Active Directory.

krb5_realm.description: Kerberos realm name (typically uppercase version of domain).

krb5_server.description: Primary KDC/DC hostname for Kerberos operations (can be IP if needed, but hostname is preferred).

allow_groups.description: Optional list of AD group names (without domain prefix) whose members may log in. If not set, deny_groups or default open access applies.

deny_groups.description: Optional list of AD group names to explicitly deny login access. Mutually exclusive with allow_groups.

cache_credentials.description: Cache credentials for offline authentication (recommended for laptops/mobile devices).

entry_cache_timeout.description: Seconds to cache directory entries. Longer timeouts reduce LDAP queries but may delay group membership changes.

ldap_referrals.description: Follow LDAP referrals (usually disabled in AD to avoid cross-forest confusion).

tls_cacert.description: Path to CA certificate bundle for LDAPS/TLS verification. Set empty string to disable verification (not recommended).

domains_config.description: Per-domain configuration blocks. One per domain listed in 'domains'.

pam_offline_expiration.description: Number of days after which cached credentials expire when offline (0 = never expire).

pam_id_disable.description: Disable ID resolution via PAM (e.g., if only authentication is needed).
